Nate shares that he recently won his first video game tournament the previous week, which he describes as exciting. Joanna congratulates Nate on his victory and asks for more details about the game. Nate reveals that the game is called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and he enjoyed the experience with his team until the very end. Joanna expresses her admiration for Nate's achievement, acknowledging that it sounds like a fun experience, even though she is not particularly into games.

episodic_summary: As of 4 November, 2022, Joanna expresses gratitude to Nate, stating that Nate's support and encouragement mean a lot to her. Joanna acknowledges that writing isn't always easy, but moments like these make her appreciate it. Joanna feels thankful for the opportunities she has and shares that last week she found old notebooks containing her early writings, which she finds cool as it shows how far she has come. Joanna shares an image: "a photo of a notebook with a list of things to write." Nate responds positively, stating that it is cool and asks Joanna if a favorite piece from her early writings stands out to her. He shares an image: "a photo of a turtle laying on a bed of rocks and gravel." Joanna recalls a story she wrote when she was 10 about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway, mentioning that she was likely inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. Joanna notes that this theme is still part of her writing today. Nate acknowledges Joanna's passion for writing, finds the story about the turtle funny, and comments on the turtle's resilience as inspiring. He encourages Joanna to take courage and keep pushing herself with her writing, complimenting her on a great job. Joanna thanks Nate again, stating that turtles make her think of strength and perseverance, which help motivate her during tough times, and she is glad Nate finds her story inspiring. Nate then expresses his love for turtles and inquires about what has been happening with Joanna.

episodic_summary: As of 14 September, 2022, Nate excitedly shares with Joanna that he hosted his own cooking show last Monday, teaching people how to make vegan ice cream recipes. Although Nate felt a bit nervous, he described the experience as a blast and mentioned that he picked up a few new recipes. Joanna congratulates Nate on his cooking show and expresses her intention to tune in, asking about his favorite dish from the show. Nate reveals that coconut milk ice cream is at the top of his list, describing it as smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist, and highlights that it is dairy-free for those who cannot have lactose or prefer vegan options. Nate shares a photograph of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon on a table. Joanna admires the ice cream, complimenting its color and texture, and asks Nate to share the recipe, expressing her desire to try making it. Nate agrees to share the recipe, emphasizing his joy in spreading dairy-free options. Joanna mentions that she recently made a delicious dessert with almond milk last Friday and inquires about Nate's favorite dairy-free desserts. Nate reiterates his love for coconut milk ice cream and adds that he also enjoys dairy-free chocolate mousse, which he describes as super creamy and tasting like the real thing. Joanna shares that her favorite dairy-free treat is an amazing chocolate raspberry tart, which features an almond flour crust and chocolate ganache topped with fresh raspberries, and she shares a photo of the tart. Nate expresses his admiration for Joanna's tart and asks what other treats she enjoys making. Joanna responds that she loves making dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries, describing it as moist and delicious with the perfect sweetness level, and shares a photo of a piece of chocolate cake with raspberries on a plate. Nate praises the cake and asks Joanna how she makes it. Joanna explains that she makes it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate, and raspberries, mentioning that it is her favorite for birthdays and special occasions. Nate expresses his eagerness to try the recipe and asks if Joanna has any other recipes to share. Joanna mentions another dessert she enjoys making, which is a delicious dessert made with blueberries and coconut milk in a gluten-free crust, describing it as creamy and delicious, and shares a photo of a piece of cake with walnuts on top. Nate is impressed by Joanna's dessert and thanks her, expressing his intention to give it a try. Joanna encourages Nate to let her know if he tries it, and they both enjoy their conversation before Nate says goodbye.
